recipes.intent: Editorial product/dev-tool: serif voice over a quiet grotesk
recipes.realWorldAnalog: Resend (Domaine + Inter + Commit Mono), Every (Signifier + Switzer)
recipes.note: All-ITF pair is safe and distinctive; add JetBrains Mono via Google.

recipes.intent: Characterful grotesk headline, neutral text
recipes.note: Use Bricolage opsz auto: >=48px picks the high-contrast display cut.

recipes.intent: One family, mono for code (maximum restraint)
recipes.realWorldAnalog: Vercel (Geist + Geist Mono), GitHub (Mona Sans + Mono)
recipes.note: Single-family sites differentiate through weight (400/500), tracking (-0.04 to -0.06em on display) and size.

recipes.intent: Neutral workhorse differentiated by tuning
recipes.realWorldAnalog: Linear (Inter Variable 510 wt, -0.022em on 64px), Raycast, Tailwind
recipes.note: Weight 510, display tracking -0.022em and opsz auto are what keep Inter from looking default.

recipes.intent: Soft old-style display, friendly sans text
recipes.realWorldAnalog: Notion-style warmth (Lyon Text accents), indie consumer tools
recipes.note: Set WONK 0, SOFT 50-100 deliberately; opsz auto.

recipes.intent: Didone display, plain grotesk text
recipes.realWorldAnalog: Fashion/hospitality; Typewolf SOTD pattern (Editorial Old + Neue Montreal)
recipes.note: Hairlines need >=32px; keep opsz auto.

recipes.intent: Serif-led reading experience with civic sans UI
recipes.realWorldAnalog: Health, legal, publishing; Anthropic (serif body + sans display)
recipes.note: Serif for long copy, sans for nav/buttons/labels.

recipes.intent: Compact geometric headline, neutral body
recipes.realWorldAnalog: Supabase (Manrope+Inter+Source Code Pro), Stripe (Sohne + Source Code Pro)
recipes.note: Weight 500-600 for H1; tabular figures for all money.

recipes.intent: Rounded-ish geometric duo for approachable apps
recipes.note: Both are common: add one personality element (colour, illustration) elsewhere.

recipes.intent: Single superfamily: sans, serif, mono from one skeleton

recipes.intent: One variable family used at wdth 62 for H1 and 100 for body

recipes.intent: Docs/long-form: serif display, grotesk UI, mono code

recipes.intent: Legibility-first for broad/older audiences
recipes.note: Choose when accessibility is a stated brand value.

recipes.intent: Expressive display, restrained text

recipes.intent: Flared serif over crisp grotesk

recipes.intent: Neutral system with one hand-lettered accent
